findings.text: non-blocking: the head run's receipt records `# command: PYTHONPATH=. .../python -m pytest ...` with no `env -u SLURM_JOB_ID`, while the done_when requires the file to pass with SLURM_JOB_ID unset and the manifest's tests line and after_suite assert that flag, so the recorded command does not show the condition was met; my re-run with the flag unset read 14 passed in 2.49s, so the measure holds and only its receipt is short.

non-blocking: the head arm's header names the node's own worktree as its tree and carries no scheduler job, so the done_when's "as a job on all_debug" is not evidenced by the log that promotion will read as the gate, and a reader cannot tell the run apart from one on any other host.

non-blocking: the fragment says the file "gains three positive cases" but the diff adds two test functions, the leaf-inside-a-peer-claim case it names having pre-existed, and its line 33 calls the classifier and no-op case fixture-preserving cases "unchanged" although their fixture paths moved from docs/evidence to docs/figures, so the evidence prose overstates what the change added.
